Subject: Lumicore — vendor enrollment: initial PO & remittance questions

Hi Jasmine / Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. We're ready to get Lumicore set up as a vendor in Redwood's AP system. I attached our signed W-9 for the US entity and our AP contact info. Before we push the supplier record live we'd like to confirm the exact PO fields and remittance data Redwood requires so our systems (and our ERP) can emit POs that map cleanly into your AP pipeline.

High level questions:
- Which PO XML element do you use for the remit-to account (ACH vs. wire)?
- Do you require an explicit VAT field or a reverse-charge flag for EU invoices?
- Is a supplier ID required to appear on the invoice exactly as in the PO?
- Do you prefer a sample PO file we can use to test parsing?

I've copied accounts-payable so they can follow up. We're happy to send a test PO and a bank letter if that helps.

Thanks,
Elena Martin
Head of Finance Operations
Lumicore, Inc.
attachments: Signed_W9_Lumicore.pdf
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@lumicore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lumicore — vendor enrollment: initial PO & remittance questions

Elena — thanks for the W-9 and the questions. Short answers below, plus next steps.

What Redwood needs from Lumicore for smooth PO/invoice processing:
- PO structure: PO number (PO_NUM), line-item quantities, and unit_price are mandatory. We prefer PO XML that includes a <RemitTo> block containing remit_name, remit_address, currency, and one or more bank nodes (type, account_number, routing/IBAN, SWIFT/BIC).
- Remit mapping: if you send both ACH and wire, include a <preferredRemit> flag. If absent we'll default to wire.
- VAT / tax: we expect a vat_number element or a vat_reverse_charge boolean on the invoice. For EU entities the VAT number must match the supplier legal name in your W-9 / tax docs.
- Supplier ID: yes — Redwood requires supplier_id to match the supplier record created in our AP portal. The supplier_id must be the same string used on incoming PO and invoice XML.

Attachments I will send: our AP onboarding packet template (Lumicore_AP_Packet_v2.pdf) which includes the exact XML snippets and required fields. Laura will attach a worked example PO XML.

Next steps: Marcus from Payments will validate the bank mapping and confirm what proof of banking we need. Once you return the completed packet and a bank letter/voided check we'll load the vendor record and ask you to submit a test PO (we'll provide a test PO number).

Can you aim to return the packet by Thursday so we can do a test on Friday?

— Jasmine Liu
Revenue Operations (Finance integrations)
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@lumicore.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Lumicore — vendor enrollment: initial PO & remittance questions

Elena — adding the packet and a sample PO XML for your integration team. See attached PO_example_4578.xml which mirrors the fields our parser expects. Notes for your team: 

- supplier_id element: must match the Vendor Legal Name in your W-9 (case-sensitive match recommended).
- currency element: ISO code required (USD / EUR / GBP).
- tax fields: include vat_number and vat_reverse_charge boolean; if vat_reverse_charge=true, include vat_note with legal basis.
- invoice submission endpoint: test invoices should be sent to invoices-test@redwood.com; production invoices go to invoices@redwood.com. Please include the PO_NUM in the invoice header and the supplier_id in the invoice XML root.
- payment terms: default is Net 30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise contracted. If you are requesting early-pay options, include a separate commercial invoice to accounts-payable@redwood.com for review.

Attachments: Lumicore_AP_Packet_v2.pdf, PO_example_4578.xml

I'll also flag this to our tax team if the reverse-charge path is being used — they may request additional paperwork for EU transactions.

Best,
Laura Bennett
AP Integration Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: Lumicore_AP_Packet_v2.pdf, PO_example_4578.xml
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@lumicore.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Bank mapping & proof-of-banking for Lumicore vendor record

Elena — quick follow on the bank/remit side. Two items from Payments: 

1) Field mapping: If you can populate these fields in the remit block it speeds up onboarding: account_type (checking/savings), account_number (last 4 for sample in the packet, full in secure field), routing_number (or IBAN), bic_swift, currency_code, preferred_remit (ACH|WIRE).

2) Proof of banking: our KYC requires either a bank letter on bank letterhead or a voided check. A PDF of the bank letter is fine. Once we have the bank letter we'll run a micro-deposit test (if ACH) or a test wire confirmation.

We do not need the full account number in the initial packet PDF — you can redline or provide last 4 digits. The secure field in the portal will accept the full account number when you complete the supplier form.

If you'd like, we can accept the bank letter and then open a scheduled 30-minute demo with our integration engineer to run the test PO through our staging endpoint.

— Marcus Lin
Payments & Settlements
Redwood Inference
